===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[NXP]] LS1046A @1.2GHz :Quad Core ARM (Cortex-A72) *Memory: 4GB (DDR4) SDRAM w/ ECC *Storage: 4MB (SPI) Flash, 128GB (M.2) SSD :[https://www.ssstc.com ''SSSTC''], a subsidiary of ''[[Kioxia]] Corporation'' :''(Solid State Storage Technology Corporation)'' *Network: 6x GbE, 2x GbE ports w/ 802.3at PoE *PCIe: 1x PCIe, 1x M.2 (M-Key) slots *USB: 2x USB 3.0 ports *Power: 54V/2.22A via 4-pin DIN
